_readme: Plain-English marker library for product pages. 'markers' defines each biomarker; 'aliases' maps the marker text used in Shopify product descriptions to one or more marker keys (optionally with a display name). Unmapped Shopify text is shown as written.

testosterone.name: Testosterone
testosterone.about: The main male sex hormone, and important for energy, libido and muscle in women too.

oestradiol.name: Oestradiol (E2)
oestradiol.about: The main form of oestrogen. Regulates the menstrual cycle, and in men is made from testosterone.

progesterone.name: Progesterone
progesterone.about: Rises after ovulation and supports the second half of the menstrual cycle.

lh.name: Luteinising hormone (LH)
lh.about: A pituitary hormone that signals the testes or ovaries to make sex hormones.

fsh.name: Follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH)
fsh.about: A pituitary hormone involved in sperm production and egg development.

shbg.name: Sex hormone-binding globulin (SHBG)
shbg.about: A protein that carries sex hormones in the blood and affects how much is available to the body.

prolactin.name: Prolactin
prolactin.about: A pituitary hormone. Raised levels can affect libido, cycles and fertility.

cortisol.name: Cortisol
cortisol.about: The body's main stress hormone. It follows a daily rhythm and is highest in the morning.

dheas.name: DHEA-S
dheas.about: An adrenal hormone the body uses to make testosterone and oestrogen.

igf1.name: IGF-1
igf1.about: Insulin-like growth factor 1, a steady marker of growth hormone activity.

gh.name: Growth hormone
gh.about: A pituitary hormone involved in growth, metabolism and body composition.

tsh.name: TSH
tsh.about: Thyroid-stimulating hormone, the first check of how well your thyroid is working.

t4.name: T4 (thyroxine)
t4.about: The main hormone produced by the thyroid.

t3.name: T3 (triiodothyronine)
t3.about: The active form of thyroid hormone used by the body's cells.

tpo.name: Thyroid peroxidase antibodies (TPO)
tpo.about: Antibodies that can point to an autoimmune thyroid condition.

tgab.name: Thyroglobulin antibodies
tgab.about: Antibodies that can point to an autoimmune thyroid condition.

trab.name: TSH receptor antibodies
trab.about: Antibodies associated with an overactive thyroid caused by autoimmunity.

thyroidab.name: Thyroid antibodies
thyroidab.about: Antibodies that can point to an autoimmune thyroid condition.

thyroglobulin.name: Thyroglobulin
thyroglobulin.about: A protein made by the thyroid gland.

lipids.name: Lipid profile
lipids.about: Total cholesterol, HDL, LDL and triglycerides, the core markers of heart health.

glucose.name: Glucose
glucose.about: Your blood sugar level, used to screen for diabetes and pre-diabetes.

hba1c.name: HbA1c
hba1c.about: Your average blood sugar over the past two to three months.

insulin.name: Fasting insulin
insulin.about: How much insulin your body needs to control blood sugar. An early marker of insulin resistance.

mba.name: General biochemistry
mba.about: A broad chemistry screen covering minerals, uric acid and related metabolic markers.

cmp.name: Comprehensive metabolic panel
cmp.about: A broad chemistry screen covering liver, kidney, electrolyte and glucose markers.

liver.name: Liver function
liver.about: Enzymes and proteins such as ALT, AST, GGT and albumin that show how your liver is working.

kidney.name: Kidney function
kidney.about: Creatinine, urea and eGFR, showing how well your kidneys filter waste.

electrolytes.name: Electrolytes
electrolytes.about: Sodium, potassium, chloride and bicarbonate, which regulate fluid balance and muscle function.

fbc.name: Full blood count
fbc.about: Red cells, white cells and platelets. Screens for anaemia, infection and other blood conditions.

esr.name: ESR
esr.about: Erythrocyte sedimentation rate, a general marker of inflammation.

crp.name: C-reactive protein (CRP)
crp.about: A general marker of inflammation in the body.

iron.name: Iron studies
iron.about: Ferritin, iron and transferrin. Shows your iron stores and screens for deficiency or overload.

vitd.name: Vitamin D
vitd.about: Supports bone health, muscle function and immunity. Low levels are common in Australia.

b12.name: Vitamin B12
b12.about: Needed for energy, red blood cell production and nerve health.

b9.name: Vitamin B9 (folate)
b9.about: Supports red blood cell production and healthy cell growth.

b6.name: Vitamin B6
b6.about: Involved in metabolism, mood regulation and immune function.

vita.name: Vitamin A
vita.about: Supports vision, immunity and skin health.

vitc.name: Vitamin C
vitc.about: An antioxidant that supports immunity and tissue repair.

psa.name: PSA
psa.about: Prostate-specific antigen, used to screen for prostate conditions.

ctng.name: Chlamydia and gonorrhoea (urine PCR)
ctng.about: Detects the two most common bacterial STIs from a urine sample.

hsv.name: Herpes simplex serology
hsv.about: Checks for antibodies to the herpes simplex virus.

syphilis.name: Syphilis serology
syphilis.about: A blood test for current or past syphilis infection.

trich.name: Trichomonas vaginalis
trich.about: Detects a common and treatable STI.

hiv.name: HIV
hiv.about: Screens for human immunodeficiency virus infection.

hepc.name: Hepatitis C antibody
hepc.about: Checks for exposure to the hepatitis C virus.
